title: Sum of Subarray Minimums

story.title: Who Is the Smallest, and for How Long?
story.text: Each tower is the minimum of every stretch reaching from just past the last smaller tower on its left to just before the next smaller on its right. Monotonic stacks find both edges.
story.goal: Return the sum of min(subarray) over all subarrays, mod 1e9+7.
